text:
sarah: Heads-up — audit alert flagged archiver uploads missing customer CMK metadata. Some DB snapshot objects were uploaded without the expected SSE-C metadata.

mike: Which archiver and logs?

sarah: archiver-service-v2. Repro looks like multipart retry path strips `x-amz-meta-sse-c` on worker retry. Example snippet we saw in the worker logs:```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z INFO upload part 3/5 retrying
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z DEBUG outgoing headers: Authorization: ****, Content-Length: 1048576
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z DEBUG metadata headers: { }, expected: {x-amz-meta-sse-c: <redacted>}
```

jordan: So objects are still SSE-S3 by bucket default? or truly cleartext?

sarah: Bucket enforces SSE-S3 fallback, so objects are encrypted at rest server-side but NOT under the tenant's CMK. Compliance risk for customers that required CMEK-backed snapshots.

priya: Wasn't there an RBAC change last week for the uploader SA? Could be missing KMS `Decrypt`/`GenerateDataKey` grants.

mike: Good call — who changed the role?

sarah: ops team rolled uploader into a narrower role `archiver-uploader` on 2026-03-19 03:00Z. The new role omitted the kms:GenerateDataKey permission. When the uploader can't call KMS it falls back and skips setting the SSE-C header.

priya: Actionable plan: 1) emergency RBAC rollback to restore KMS grants, 2) patch archiver so multipart retry preserves metadata headers, 3) audit to find affected object list and notify tenants.

encops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-123 (archiver-cmek-degradation). Assigned: @ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: Oncall here — starting RBAC rollback now. Will confirm when KMS grants are restored and run a small end-to-end upload test.

mike: Also need to decide whether to re-wrap existing objects with CMK or require tenants to re-run backups. Any quick remediation for already-uploaded objects?

sarah: Short-term: re-encrypt in-place by copying object with `aws s3 cp` and forcing SSE-C/CMEK headers (requires uploader SA to have kms:Encrypt). Script I'm running to enumerate candidates:```
aws s3api list-objects --bucket snapshots-prod --prefix "prod/" --query "Contents[?contains(Key, '2026-03-20')].Key" --output text > /tmp/archiver-affected.txt
while read k; do aws s3 cp s3://snapshots-prod/$k s3://snapshots-prod/$k --metadata-directive REPLACE --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:...; done
```

priya: Add tests: multipart retry integration test + a unit test to assert metadata preservation. Also we should add an alert rule for `s3_object_missing_cmek_tag` so ops get paged before audit catches it.

jordan: Compliance note — we should notify the compliance lead and prepare customer-facing communication if tenants were affected.

sarah: I'll open the hotfix PR and include the RBAC rollback steps in the incident doc. Timeline: RBAC rollback ETA 15m, hotfix rollout ETA 2h, audit run ETA 6h, postmortem draft by EOD. Tagging @security for review :eyes:

mike: +1. Thanks for the clear plan.

ops-oncall: RBAC rollback complete. Confirmed KMS grants restored to `archiver-uploader`. End-to-end test passed (uploaded sample snapshot now has CMK tag).

sarah: Great — starting re-encrypt batch and posting PR link in incident.

priya: I'll start writing the alert and tests.

jordan: Please include a remediation checklist for customers who pulled snapshots during the window.

sarah: Will do — thanks everyone.
